# K's House Japan

> > K's House operates a network of hostels and guesthouses across Japan's most popular destinations including Kyoto, Tokyo, Kanazawa, Hiroshima, Takayama, Hakone, Mt. Fuji, Hakuba, Nikko, and Ito Onsen.

K's House provides budget accommodation with cultural events, onsen facilities, and multilingual staff support throughout Japan. The hostel chain serves international travelers with locations near major tourist attractions, ski resorts, and traditional hot spring areas.
